D37. 俄国士官生自杀案
1929年2月6日。瓦西里·别斯帕尔科夫（Vasily Bespalkeff）与弗拉基米尔
凯戈罗德采夫（Vladimir Kaigorodtzeff）。

Form
C. 356

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
GENERAL DIVISION
File No.
Date 6. 2. 29
19）

Subject (in full) Suicide of Russian Cadets.

Made by D.S. Ovsianikoff Forwarded by J.P. Ewens A.B. Pol

With reference to the attached article from "The China
Press" dated January 31, 1929, inquiries go to show that
Vasily Bespalkeff, [涂改] 23 years of age, Military Cadet
of Habarovsk Cadet Corps, residing at 439 Avenue Joffre, who
committed suicide on January 30, 1929 by taking a large dose
of veronal [涂改] buried in the Lu'Ka Wei Cemetery on January
31, 1929 while [涂改] other Russian cadet named Vladimir
Kaigerodtzeff, who [涂改] attempted suice by swallowing a
quantity of the same poison, was detained in the Russian
Orthodox Fraternity Hospital and has since recovered and left
the Hospital on February 2, 1929.

It appears that both men were unemployed for some
time and after a drinking bout lasting several days decided to
commit suicide. They obtained veronal from a Chemists' Shop
in Avenue Joffre and on the morning of January 29 drank it
in a quantity of beer; after which one V. Kaigerodtzeff went to
a lady friend living in Avenue Joffre, where he became sick
and was promptly removed to St. Marie's Hospital. He was
refused admittance and was taken to the Russian Orthodox
Hospital where he was detained until he recovered. Bespalkeff
remained at 439 Avenue Joffre where he succumbed to the
poison.

V. Orliaminov
D. S.

（批：RWM）
（批：MR. 5/9）
N. D. C. I.

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记科
总务组
档案号
日期 1929年2月6日
19）

事由（全称） 俄国士官生自杀案。

呈报人 D.S. 奥夫相尼科夫（D.S. Ovsianikoff） 转呈人 J.P. 尤恩斯（J.P. Ewens） A.B. Pol

关于附上的1929年1月31日《字林西报》（The China Press）文章，经查询显示，
瓦西里·别斯帕尔科夫（Vasily Bespalkeff），[涂改] 23岁，哈巴罗夫斯克士官团（Habarovsk Cadet Corps）士官生，居住于霞飞路439号，于1929年1月30日服用大量佛罗那（veronal）[涂改] 自杀，于1929年1月31日安葬于卢家湾公墓；与此同时 [涂改] 另一名名为弗拉基米尔·凯戈罗德采夫（Vladimir Kaigerodtzeff）的俄国士官生，[涂改] 吞服同种毒药企图自杀，被收容于俄罗斯东正教兄弟会医院，此后康复并于1929年2月2日出院。

据悉，两人已失业一段时间，在持续数日的酗酒之后决定自杀。他们从霞飞路的一家药房购得佛罗那，并于1月29日上午将其混入大量啤酒中饮下；随后，V. 凯戈罗德采夫前往一位居住在霞飞路的女性友人处，在那里感到不适，随即被送往圣玛丽医院（St. Marie's Hospital）。该院拒绝收治，遂将其转送至俄罗斯东正教医院，他在那里留院直至康复。别斯帕尔科夫则留在霞飞路439号，终因中毒身亡。

V. 奥尔利亚米诺夫（V. Orliaminov）
D. S.

（批注：RWM）
（批注：MR. 5/9）
N. D. C. I.

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, FEBRUARY 8, 1930.

Death has ended the suffering
of a young Russian who, with an-
other youth, swallowed poison in
a room on Avenue Joffre recently.
The suicide pact resulted in the
immediate death of one youth, the
other being taken to a private
hospital, where for several days
he hovered between life and death.
He died on Friday after expres-
sing a wish to live and atone for
his rash act. Efforts are being
made by the French police and
members of the local Russian
Community to find the relatives
of the deceased.
pages.zh:
《上海星期时报》，1930年2月8日。

死亡终结了一位年轻俄国人的痛苦，他不久前与另一位青年在霞飞路的一间房间内服毒。这次自杀约定导致其中一名青年立即死亡，另一人被送往一家私立医院，在那里生死徘徊数日。他在周五去世，此前曾表示希望活下去并为自己的鲁莽行为赎罪。法国警察和当地俄国社区成员正在努力寻找死者的亲属。
